programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.sub-title: Ottawa Senators at Toronto Maple Leafs

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.sub-title: Toronto Maple Leafs at Ottawa Senators
programme.desc: The Maple Leafs try to put a stranglehold on their East first-round series with the Senators in Game 3. Max Domi ripped the overtime winner just over three minutes into the first extra frame of Game 2 to give Toronto a 3-2 win, and a 2-0 series lead.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.sub-title: Toronto Maple Leafs at Ottawa Senators
programme.desc: The Maple Leafs look to swiftly end the Senators' playoff return, up 3-0 in Game 4 of their first-round set. Simon Benoit, who scored six goals in his first 288 NHL games, slapped home the overtime winner in Toronto's 3-2 Game 3 victory over Ottawa.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.sub-title: Ottawa Senators at Toronto Maple Leafs
programme.desc: The Senators try to continue their comeback in Game 5 of their first-round set with the Maple Leafs. Jake Sanderson saved Ottawa's season and prevented a third straight overtime loss when the defenseman scored in a 4-3 win over Toronto in Game 4.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.sub-title: Toronto Maple Leafs at Ottawa Senators
programme.desc: The Senators continue a comeback attempt as they host the Maple Leafs in Game 6 of an East quarterfinal. Linus Ullmark made 29 saves as Ottawa blanked Toronto 4-0 in Game 5 to stay alive. Tim Stützle notched a goal and two assists for the Sens.

UFC stands for the Ultimate Fighting Championship which is an American mixed martial arts (MMA) promotion company based in Las Vegas that is owned by William Morris Endeavour.The purpose of UFC fighting was to establish the most effective martial art in a contest that had no weight classes and minimal rules that were as follows: no biting, hair pulling, groin shots and eye gouging. Legendary fighters well known for their ability to win in UFC fighting are Anderson Silva, Brock Lesnar, Connor McGregor and Ken Shamrock. Women's MMA has seen Ronda Rousey defend her title from 2012 to 2015 before she was defeated by Holly Holm another belt holder in more than one martial art.

St. Vincent
programme.desc: Maggie, a working single mother, allows Vincent, a hedonistic misanthrope, to babysit her 12-year-old son Oliver. Soon, a beautiful friendship develops between Vincent and Oliver.

programme.title: The Great Dictator
programme.desc: After suffering from memory loss, a soldier returns to his former profession as a barber and attempts to escape persecution by the military forces.

programme.title: Down With Love
programme.desc: Catcher Block, a womanising journalist, tries to make feminist author Barbara Novak fall in love with him. However, his ploy backfires when he has feelings for her.

programme.title: Meet Dave
programme.desc: A human-shaped spaceship, controlled by 100 mini humanoid aliens, lands on earth. However, things take an unexpected turn for the small aliens when their captain falls for a woman named Gina.

programme.title: Big Mommas: Like Father, Like Son
programme.desc: After FBI agent Malcolm Turner's stepson, Trent, witnesses a murder, the two are forced to go undercover. While Malcolm turns into Big Momma, Trent disguises himself as Charmaine.

programme.title: Burnt
programme.desc: Fallen from grace, ill-tempered chef Adam Jones returns to London, determined to reclaim his torn glory by leading his crew towards the third michelin star.

programme.title: The Smurfs 2
programme.desc: When Gargamel learns that Smurfette knows a secret spell that can turn Naughties, Smurf-like creatures, into real Smurfs, he kidnaps her. The Smurfs set out to rescue Smurfette.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
programme.desc: Alvin, Simon and Theodore believe that Dave is going to propose to his girlfriend, Samantha, in Miami. In a bid to retain their place in Dave's life, the three set out to stop him.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Grace, who is vacationing in Paris with her friends and stepsister, is mistaken for a British heiress. Later, the three women are whisked away to Monte Carlo, where they discover royalty and romance.

programme.title: Penelope
programme.desc: A young girl hailing from an affluent family embarks on a quest for true love to dispel a curse that has pervaded her family.

programme.title: Kung Fu Yoga
programme.desc: An archeology expert joins an Indian professor to look for a lost treasure of India. However, things take a dangerous turn when they are ambushed in their quest.

programme.title: The Rewrite
programme.desc: Keith Michaels, an Oscar-winning writer, teaches at the Binghamton University on the East Coast after losing his popularity in Hollywood and falls in love with Holly, a fellow teacher.

programme.title: Land of the Bears
programme.desc: The filmmaker shines a light on the lives of five wild brown bears inhabiting the Kamchatka Peninsula, exploring their daily adventures and activities.

programme.title: The Love Laugh Live Show

programme.title: Lay the Favorite

programme.title: Love Is in the Air
programme.desc: Antonie and Julie, past lovers, coincidently find themselves seated next to each other on a flight. As conversation ensues, past memories are revived, as they strive to understand each other again.

programme.title: Gone Girl
programme.desc: On his fifth anniversary, Nick Dunne reports his wife missing. As his portrait of a blissful union begins to crumble, suspicions of murder build.

programme.title: The Butler
programme.desc: Significant events in America like the Civil Rights Movement and the Vietnam War affect the life of a butler, Cecil, who, during his tenure, served eight presidents at the White House.

programme.title: Birdman
programme.desc: Chaos erupt when Riggan Thomson, a former superstar, produces a promising Broadway show in a desperate attempt to revive his career.

programme.title: Woman in Gold

programme.title: The Negotiator
programme.desc: When a hostage negotiator is falsely accused of murdering his partner, he employs desperate measures in order to clear his name.

programme.title: Boychoir

programme.title: The Artist

programme.title: Entrapment

programme.title: Fight Club
